title: Saksi-saksi nyang ka binasa
intro: Bak masa jameun, saboh komunitas tinggai di simpang jalan antara keurajeuen-keurajeuen. Nabi awaknyan geutawök awaknyan ubak jalan nyang beutôi, bah kheueh meunan awaknyan teutab meuikat ubak keukafiran dan keuzalisan. Kisah nyoe meuakhé deungon balasan ilahi. Jeuët neuidentifikasi bansa njoë dan nasib awaknjan dari petunjuk di mijub njoë?
clues: Saboh bansa jitulak peuingat nyang jiba lé salah sidroe utusan awaknyan keudroe.
Rasul geuyue geutanyoe beu ta ibadat keu Allah mantong dan geupeuingat bek na korupsi.
Peulanggaran kamoe na kheueh kamoe tulak nabi nyang geukirém lamkawan kamoe deungon keubeunaran.
Kamoe ragu keukuasaan utusan nyan dan kamoe tudoh gobnyan peungeut.
Huköman nyan jiteuka ateueh kamoe watée kamoe tinggai deungon aman di rumoh kamoe.
Kamoe ka hanco sabab kamoe tulak nabi kamoe dan kamoe aniaya ureueng-ureueng meuiman.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Teurimong nabi nyang geutawök keu keubeunaran .
trial.answer: Teurimong nabi nyang geutawök keu keubeunaran .

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
